name: Lakeville Winter Match Play
oneLiner: The long one: fourteen weeks of handicapped match play from January to mid-April, each night its own league with its own table to climb.
beginnerNote: You play your own ball and the team takes the better score, so there is always a partner covering the hole you would rather forget. No handicap yet? You start at zero until the system works you out.
format: 2-person team-vs-team match play, best ball, handicapped
prizes: Top 4 teams from each night played off for 1st, 2nd and 3rd
nextSeasonNote: This is how it ran before. The 2026 fall lineup is published and open for registration.
